wins.text: Total revenue of $44B, up 69% YoY, exceeding outlook; Data Center revenue of $39B grew 73% YoY driven by Blackwell ramp
Gaming revenue hit a record $3.8B, up 48% sequentially and 42% YoY, with Blackwell the fastest gaming GPU ramp ever
Networking revenue surged 64% QoQ to $5B; Spectrum-X now annualizing over $8B in revenue with Google Cloud and Meta added as new customers
Blackwell contributed nearly 70% of Data Center compute revenue; major hyperscalers each deploying ~1,000 NVL72 racks (~72,000 Blackwell GPUs) per week
Returned a record $14.3B to shareholders via share repurchases and dividends in Q1

risks.text: H20 export ban resulted in a $4.5B inventory/purchase obligation write-down and inability to ship $2.5B in Q1 revenue; Q2 outlook reflects ~$8B loss in H20 revenue with no replacement product currently available
China AI accelerator market (~$50B TAM) effectively closed to NVIDIA with no compliant product to offer; foreign competitors stand to benefit
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins compressed to 60.5% and 61% respectively in Q1 due to the $4.5B H20 charge; underlying margins of 71.3% only slightly above outlook
Tariff-related uncertainty temporarily impacted Pro Visualization demand in Q1; revenue flat sequentially at $509M
GB200 NVL rack systems described as 'complex to build,' with manufacturing yields and rack shipment ramp still in progress, creating execution risk on the Blackwell transition

guidance_items.detail: Q2 total revenue guided to $45B +/- 2%, up from Q1's $44B; modest sequential growth expected across all platforms despite ~$8B H20 headwind
Q2 GAAP/non-GAAP gross margins guided to 71.8%/72% +/- 50bps, recovering sharply from Q1's 60.5%/61% impacted by H20 charge; targeting mid-70s range by late FY26
GAAP/non-GAAP tax rates expected at 16.5% +/- 1%; other income ~$450M
Full-year FY26 operating expense growth expected in mid-30% range; Q2 GAAP/non-GAAP opex ~$5.7B and ~$4B respectively

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Whether a new China-compliant SKU replacement for H20 is in development and timeline for re-entering the China market
Magnitude of the H20 revenue headwind relative to Street expectations and how much the non-China business is outperforming to offset it
Specific lead times and order backlog visibility for Blackwell given the surge in large sovereign/hyperscaler cluster announcements
